{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
filtered_sales = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of customers with valid age data
mean_age = filtered_sales['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f'Mean age of customers with valid age data: {mean_age}')"}
